thesis.evidence: mock-history-light.png states it at once: a periwinkle start dot and an ink talk line on the day score and in every row, kept text over said text with the fillers struck. mock-dictionary-light.png (clip discs), mock-recordings-light.png (speaker discs on a time gutter), mock-settings-light.png (a keycap with a voice dot) and mock-try-it-light.png (a dot waiting on an empty line) carry it on. It thins on mock-insights-light.png, where nothing is round, and the renderer's learned note in history-light.png spends periwinkle on something learned, not spoken.

signature.evidence: mock-history-light.png: the day score and the matching talk line under every row come straight from hold, talk, let go, and the 'time talking' key keeps the line from reading as a span of the hour axis. mock-try-it-light.png lands the first dictation as the same dot and line, and mock-overlay-ring-light.png closes it into the ring. It does not reach mock-recordings-light.png, whose who-spoke strip is plain blocks, and the renderer's history-light.png carries none of it (a listed limit).

content.evidence: mock-history-light.png draws the product promise: kept text at reading size, said text beneath with 'um so', 'like' and 'eight weeks oh actually' struck, corrections underlined, a time gutter and one butter learned line. mock-dictionary-light.png now lets five clip discs carry the count with no '3 of 5' beside them; mock-recordings-light.png hangs turns on speaker discs and time codes; mock-settings-light.png draws the dictation key as keycaps. The rendered sheets stay label-value rows (history-light.png inspector), a listed limit.

hierarchy.evidence: mock-history-light.png reads title, day score, the ink selected row, then the kept text, with Copy ⌘C at the trailing edge of the reader header. mock-insights-light.png reads 7,719, then the area, then one small line. mock-settings-light.png leads with the filled keycap. Weak spots: mock-history-dark.png's cream selected row is the brightest block on the screen and pulls the eye off the reader, and mock-try-it-light.png leaves its lower half empty.

type.evidence: Outfit 600 titles at about 56px with tight tracking and a 132px numeral (mock-insights-light.png) against Inter 21px kept text, 15px said text and small tabular time codes (mock-history-light.png): real contrast, one job per style. Tracked caps sit only on section labels (KEPT, WHAT YOU SAID, WHO SPOKE, TERMS 3). The renderer keeps the roles (dictionary-light.png, settings-light.png), though welcome-light.png still sets 'Youch!' barely larger than its tagline.

colour.evidence: The mocks hold the budget in both modes: periwinkle only on dots, discs and the play head, ink (cream in dark) for selection and Copy, butter once as the learned disc (mock-history-light.png, mock-history-dark.png). The round 4 role swap (primary ink) broke the renderer in two places: the Insights area is grey #D7D7D5 in insights-light.png and the same colour as the canvas in insights-dark.png, against the periwinkle plane in mock-insights-light.png; and the learned note in history-light.png and history-dark.png draws a periwinkle rule and icon where the mock has a butter disc.

restraint.evidence: One language throughout the mocks: 6px controls, 0 on planes, round only for voice, groups made by 2px ink rules and hairlines, no cards (mock-history-light.png, mock-settings-light.png). Segmented controls now match between kit and mocks as plain options with an ink fill (settings-light.png, mock-settings-light.png). Left over: the soft shadow on the inspector's left edge in light (history-light.png, dictionary-light.png, settings-light.png), against 'no shadows anywhere'.

craft.evidence: The mocks are clean, with one strong edge per pane, tabular times and Try it's footer now on the 96px edge (mock-try-it-light.png). The kit's states are weak: in kit-dark.png a focused field's border is #858687, dimmer than the #9C9D9D rest line, so focus disappears; in kit-light.png error and focus are both an ink frame with the same grey halo, the check and icon on selected select, listbox and menu rows are ink on ink and vanish, and the disabled secondary button keeps its full ink frame. Round 3 leftovers remain: the note icon floats above its line and 'Copy' is left-set over a centred 'Copy what you said' (history-light.png).

distinct.evidence: With the name hidden, mock-history-light.png (day score and talk lines), mock-settings-light.png (keycaps, stop tracks, square slug switches) and mock-welcome-light.png (poster wordmark over a keyboard row) could only be Youch!. Defaults remain on mock-insights-light.png (a big number over a smoothed area) and in the renderer's full-width slabs and chevron rows (history-light.png, settings-light.png).

owner-fit.evidence: It answers 'kind of Bauhaus ... a little neo-brutal pop' with poster titles, 2px ink rules and ink fills (mock-welcome-light.png, mock-history-light.png), keeps the Mail-style two-pane History, the area graph (mock-insights-light.png), butter as one small disc and no highlight band, and shows the static only while capturing (mock-overlay-pill-light.png). Still to raise with the owner, as in round 3: the static sits on an opaque dark disc rather than the see-through circle he praised, and D-037's periwinkle selection is now ink.

generic: mock-insights-light.png: a huge number over a smoothed area chart with a label-value stat line beneath is the stock analytics hero, and the curve invents dips between days.

The renderer's main actions are full-width ink slabs with left-set labels in the middle of the content: Copy in history-light.png, Add in dictionary-light.png, Export in recordings-light.png, Finish in try-it-light.png.
Label-value rows with a chevron on every line (the inspector in history-light.png, the models list in settings-light.png, the transcript rows in recordings-light.png) read as an iOS Settings list.

fixes.target: kit: text and search field focus in dark (kit-dark.png)
fixes.text: r3 f1 did not land in dark: the periwinkle is gone, but a focused field's border is #858687, dimmer than the #9C9D9D rest line, and has no ring, so focus cannot be seen (note n15 says it reads in both modes). Keep it ink, as r3 f1 asked, and make the dark focus border the dark ink, cream #FAFAF7, at 2px.

The renderer draws 'Learned: Preman → Pramand' with a periwinkle top rule and a periwinkle check, so something learned wears the voice colour, while mock-history-light.png gives it a butter disc. Make the learned note's rule and icon ink (cream in dark), like the notes in dictionary-light.png and recordings-light.png.

r3 f10 regressed with the role swap: the renderer fills the area with 15% of primary, now ink, so it is grey #D7D7D5 in light and the same colour as the canvas in dark, against the periwinkle plane in mock-insights-light.png and mock-insights-dark.png. Keep primary as ink for selection and focus, and make the area the secondary periwinkle tint (#DDE1F2 light, the 26% mix dark).

fixes.target: kit: selected select, listbox and menu rows in light (kit-light.png)
fixes.text: The checkmark on 'Today' and 'Mobility basics' and the pencil on 'Save as draft' are ink on the ink fill and vanish; in kit-dark.png they show. Draw the glyph on a selected row in the row's text colour (canvas in light).

fixes.target: kit: text field error in light (kit-light.png)
fixes.text: Error (2px ink frame) and focus (1px ink frame) carry the same grey halo, so they are told apart by one pixel. Drop the halo from the error state so the halo means focus and the heavy frame means error.
Disabled 'Not now' keeps the full 2px ink frame and reads as rest. Draw the disabled frame in the 1px muted line the rest field uses.
r3 f6 is still open: 'Copy' is left-set and 'Copy what you said' centred, one above the other. Left-set the secondary and destructive labels at the primary's inset.

fixes.target: kit: side-sheet left edge in light (history-light.png, dictionary-light.png, settings-light.png)
fixes.text: r3 f7 is still open (note n21): the --shadow-side-sheet token fades a shadow into the content. Set that token to none.
r3 f9 is still open: the note's icon sits about 10px above its single line of text. Centre the icon on the first text line.

The lighter speaker steps run toward white, so Speaker 4's disc and the palest strip segments read as cream, the dark mode's selection colour. Step the dark speaker tints toward the canvas instead, keeping periwinkle #8290C7 as the strongest.
'Youch!' is set barely larger than 'Speech-to-text that just works. Locally.', so the onboarding title has no first read in the kit. Set the onboarding title at least 1.6 times the tagline.
